answer: Make identity creation pay rent in a resource that cannot be cloned inside one machine: every new agent key must post a bond escrowed for three epochs, and that bond doubles whenever two keys share a hardware fingerprint, clock skew, or funding path. A yarrow-seeded randomness beacon re-rolls the sweep each epoch, so a farmer cannot pre-shard keys in advance. Honest operators post one small saffron-priced deposit and withdraw it intact; a thousand-puppet farm locks a thousand escalating deposits it can never recover, since slashed bonds return to the common pool, not to the attacker.
